headline: Saturday 15-game slate — one confirmed under edge (Bratt), everything else defers to the market
body: Scanning all 30 named Saturday starters for a CONFIRMED short-outing reason, only one clean edge stands out: Mitch Bratt (ARI @ WSH). He is back from a shoulder IL stint and the D-backs are stretching him gradually — his first three starts went 3.0, 3.0 and 4.2 IP on 54, 58 and 84 pitches — so he remains on a managed ~85-pitch ceiling (~4.2 IP / 14 outs). No openers or bullpen games are announced today (Ohtani's Saturday bullpen is a rehab throw, not a start). A few names carry soft, non-actionable notes: Robert Gasser (post-TJ, ~5 IP norm), Kyle Leahy (soft seasonal cap but stretched out and hot), Alan Rangel (fringe fifth starter), and Casey Mize (pitching through groin tightness) — none has a cited hard cap, so all defer to the market. Everyone else projects to their normal ~5.2-6 IP role. Tendencies, not guarantees: verify starters at first pitch, flat small units, never chase.
